transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because I just keep messing up little things. Nothing major, just... small stuff. Like writing the wrong time down on a class sheet over at the senior center. Or I'll measure a board for a project and still cut it a hair short... I just sort of skip over the small print, I guess. That's... that's mostly it.
How long have you been noticing these kinds of mistakes happening?
I don't know... hard to say exactly. I guess I've noticed it getting in the way more since we moved into the condo. That was... about a year and a month ago. Just around then, I suppose.
Looking back to when you were in school or younger, did you have similar troubles with paying attention and making careless mistakes, or is this completely new?

I suppose it's not completely new. Um... even back in elementary school, my teachers would write on my report cards that I was bright, but... I'd forget my books or lose my homework. They said I'd just stare out the window unless someone reminded me to focus. So... yeah, I guess it's been around a while.
Do you often find yourself feeling restless, fidgeting, or having difficulty sitting still?

I suppose... a little. Sometimes if I'm sitting through a long meeting at the center, or just trying to have a quiet evening at the condo... I get this sort of ants-in-my-pants feeling. I just want to get up and check on something, or... putter around. But it's nothing major.
Do you often have trouble organizing your daily tasks or managing your schedule?

Well... I guess I do, sometimes. If I have a lot going on in one day, like... a few errands, and maybe getting ready for a workshop... plus an appointment. I just... I don't know where to start. I'll start one thing, then stop, and... I just end up rushing around at the end trying to get it all done.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted by things happening around you or by unrelated thoughts when you are trying to concentrate?

I guess so. Um... like if I'm at the senior center, and... people are talking at the next table. Or if my phone lights up. My mind just sort of... jumps over there. And then I'll lose my place in whatever I was filling out, or... whatever I was building. So... yes.
Do you frequently forget to do routine daily tasks, like paying bills, keeping appointments, or returning phone calls?

I don't think so. I mean, my bills are on autopay... and I usually write appointments on the calendar in the kitchen. I guess I don't really have a lot of phone calls to return these days. So... no, not really.
